title: Golden Hour
description: Golden Hour takes its name from the light it keeps — the warm, slanting glow of the day's final hour, caught and held in the centre stone. Bez Ambar sets the diamond so its colour reads warm and full, the surrounding design kept quiet enough that nothing cools it. Light gathers in the stone and returns soft and golden as the hand moves, never sharp, never cold. It is a ring built around a mood as much as a diamond — light shaped to feel like the hour it is named for, and made to carry that warmth with you.
subtitle: The warm, low light of the day's last hour, held in a single stone.
